insight.detail: The web-app pod cannot reach its configured API dependency. DNS resolution for 'api-service.staging' is failing: no such host. This is causing the container to exit on startup and enter CrashLoopBackOff.

Pod 'web-app-pod' in namespace 'default' is in CrashLoopBackOff with 7 restarts. The container exits with code 1 during startup dependency checks. Last termination message: 'API dependency check failed: unable to reach http://api-service.staging:8080/health'.

insight.primary: Deployment web-app Has No Available Replicas
insight.detail: Deployment 'web-app' in namespace 'default' reports 0 ready replicas out of 2 desired. The deployment is in a degraded state and no traffic can be served.
Service 'api-service' in namespace 'default' has 1 ready endpoint (10.244.1.50:8080). The service itself is reachable within the default namespace.
